🌟 Scribe | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: A unified environment for scientists to write research papers, embed dynamic content from Python notebooks, and manage all related assets locally.
✨ Key Features: • Integrated LaTeX paper editing with Python notebooks and figures • Local compilation using Tectonic or TeX Live • CodeMirror 6 editor with LaTeX-specific features (completion, snippets, hover info) • Support for TikZ diagrams
📖 Summary: Scribe is a desktop LaTeX editor designed for scientists, integrating LaTeX papers with Python notebooks and figures into a single project. It allows for seamless compilation of documents on the user's machine using Tectonic or TeX Live, ensuring privacy and local control.
